name: Madeira
title: Holidays in Madeira
intro: Spring weather all year, toboggans down the streets and cliff walks along old water channels. Here's what Madeira is like with the family and when to go.
facts_note: The EU is bringing in new entry checks, so check the rules on GOV.UK before you book.
when_to_go: Madeira is mild all year, so it's a good bet for winter sun without a long flight. Spring is full of flowers, and September has the warmest sea. New Year's Eve brings one of the biggest firework displays in the world.

things.name: Monte toboggan
things.blurb: Slide down the hill in a wicker sledge steered by two men in straw hats.

things.name: Funchal cable car
things.blurb: Ride up from the seafront to the gardens in Monte.

things.name: Levada walks
things.blurb: Flat paths along old water channels. Levada do Rei is a good family one.

things.name: Porto Moniz pools
things.blurb: Natural swimming pools in the volcanic rock, filled by the sea.

things.name: Whale and dolphin trip
things.blurb: Dolphins are seen on most trips, and whales at many times of year.

things.name: Pico do Arieiro
things.blurb: Drive up to 1,800 metres and look down on the clouds.

faqs.question: Is Madeira good for a family holiday?
faqs.answer: Yes, for families who like being outdoors. It's safe and easy, with walks, boat trips and pools. It has few sandy beaches, so pick a hotel with a good pool.

faqs.question: How many nights do you need?
faqs.answer: A week gives you time for walks, a boat trip and a lazy day or two. Hiring a car makes the island much easier to explore.

faqs.question: Do UK families need a visa?
faqs.answer: No, Madeira is part of Portugal, so British passport holders can visit for up to 90 days in any 180 without a visa. New EU entry checks are being brought in, so check GOV.UK before you travel.

faqs.question: Is the flight into Madeira safe?
faqs.answer: Yes. The airport's short runway and winds make landings feel dramatic, and flights are sometimes diverted in strong winds, but pilots train specially for it.
